name: Pharmaceutical lyophilization cycle in vials: freezing at -50 C, primary drying at -10 C and 180 mTorr, secondary drying at 40 C
plain_name: Freeze-dry a medicine into a shelf-stable powder
description: A nucleic-acid lipid-nanoparticle drug product is frozen on the shelves at -50 C, primary-dried at a shelf temperature of -10 C under 180 mTorr chamber pressure and secondary-dried at 40 C (optimised variant: -15 C primary, 30 C secondary) in a pilot freeze dryer, with the sublimed water captured on the ice condenser. This is the standard cycle structure for parenteral lyophilised drug products.
keywords: Freeze-dry a medicine into a shelf-stable powder

sources.citation: T. Alejo, A. Toro-Córdova, L. Fernández, A. Rivero, A. M. Stoian, L. Pérez, V. Navarro, J. Martínez-Oliván, D. de Miguel, Comprehensive Optimization of a Freeze-Drying Process Achieving Enhanced Long-Term Stability and In Vivo Performance of Lyophilized mRNA-LNPs, Int. J. Mol. Sci. 25(19):10603 (2024)

S. Tchessalov, V. Maglio, P. Kazarin, A. Alexeenko, B. Bhatnagar, E. Sahni, E. Shalaev, Practical Advice on Scientific Design of Freeze-Drying Process: 2023 Update, Pharmaceutical Research 40(10):2433-2455 (2023)

reported_equipment: Virtis Genesis Pilot Freeze Dryer (SP, Warminster, PA, USA)

requirements.rationale: The shelves must span the whole recipe, from the -50 C freezing step to the 40 C secondary-drying step.
Freezing is done on the shelves at -50 C; a dryer whose shelves cannot reach -50 C cannot execute this freezing step.
Primary drying is sublimation under vacuum; without an evacuated product chamber there is no lyophilisation.
Primary drying runs at 180 mTorr (0.18 Torr) chamber pressure, so the dryer must pump at least that low.
The procedure is a freeze-drying cycle: the machine must be a lyophiliser with controllable shelves and an ice condenser, not merely a cold evacuated space.

Optional: pharmaceutical primary drying is almost always controlled between 50 and 200 mTorr, so a dryer must be able to hold a set pressure inside that window rather than only pump to its ultimate vacuum.
